AND (n.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{dto.keyword}, '%') OR n.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{dto.keyword}, '%'))
AND r.id IS NOT NULL
AND r.id IS NULL
ORDER BY n.is_top DESC, n.publish_time DESC, n.id DESC
